text: On an annual basis, the Auditor General reviews the implementation status of outstanding audit recommendations and reports the review results to City Council through the City's Audit Committee. This report provides the implementation status of the audit recommendations contained in the report entitled "Toronto Parking Authority Phase 2: Audit of the Revenue Operations of Off-Street Controlled Facilities" dated January 12, 2016. The audit report is available at: http://app.toronto.ca/tmmis/viewAgendaItemHistory.do?item=2016.AU5.5 . The audit report contains 12 recommendations. In prior follow-up reviews, we determined that eight recommendations have been fully implemented. During the current follow-up process, management reported that the outstanding four recommendations have been partially implemented.
